name: Contamine Fongique
description: Née de la contamination, Contamine Fongique est une abomination fongique avide de biomasse. Son corps en décomposition libère des nuages de spores toxiques qui consomment la matière organique pour alimenter l'expansion inexorable du Fléau.

subject.archetype: Fungal Contaminator Combat Specialist - grotesque bio-horror hybrid merging corrupted soldier silhouette with pulsating mycological growths, asymmetrically bloated torso erupting with bulbous fungal sacs, limbs stretched and disfigured by sprawling mycelial tendrils

loadout.armor_outfit: Destroyed military exoskeleton fractured and spread apart by violent internal fungal eruption, rusted metal plates separated and held together by thick ropes of living mycelium, no symmetry remaining, polypore fruiting bodies erupting from shoulder plates, branch-like fungal gills protruding from neck area
loadout.arsenal: Corrupted automatic rifle completely engulfed in pulsating biomass, weapon barrel replaced with organic nozzle secreting acidic mucus, magazine replaced by bulging spore sac, toxic green veins pulsing along the weapon, fungal tendrils wrapping around the grip

attitude.behavior: Aggressive combat stance with weapon raised high, torso leaning forward into attack, legs planted wide on living fungal ground, one arm extended holding corrupted rifle pointed at target, body covered in freshly burst spore clouds, posture coiled and explosive
attitude.emotion: mindless hunger and organic malevolence radiating from hollow eye sockets now filled with bioluminescent fungal clusters, twisted jaw hanging open releasing constant stream of toxic spores

palette_names.name: Toxic Fluorescent Green
palette_names.role: Primary bioluminescent accent illuminating subject and creating eerie glow on fungal elements

palette_names.name: Sickly Putrid Green
palette_names.role: Main atmospheric color dominating spore clouds and haze

palette_names.name: Moldy Brown Gray
palette_names.role: Base color of mycological growths and decomposing terrain

palette_names.name: Necrotic Flesh Pink
palette_names.role: Exposed biological tissue being overtaken by infection

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Harsh backlighting from toxic bioluminescent sources with thick atmospheric haze creating volumetric god rays through spore clouds, low intensity ambient light with green OSL (Object Source Lighting) on all fungal elements
color_and_light.mood: Oppressively menacing, horrifying, apocalyptic - sense of inevitable contamination and organic dread

camera.angle: low_angle looking up at the contaminator silhouette against the green haze, emphasizing monstrous scale and threatening presence

scenography.setting: Biologically devastated battlefield completely consumed by fungal infestation, ground transformed into pulsating living organism with visible mycelial networks spreading across destroyed terrain, massive fungal towers erupting from craters, skeletal remains half-dissolved being overtaken by rapid growth
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick toxic spore clouds reducing visibility to create oppressive green haze, massive pulsating sacs constantly bursting releasing contamination, ground alive and hostile with fungal tendrils bursting through dirt, mycelial networks visibly pulsing and growing in real-time, toxic green fog rolling across battlefield
